source_evidence:
Exact player 'if you couldn’t tell, very little. Whatever sealed me for all this time must have affected my memory too.

What else do you know about the ancestral seat?' V tells Ysendre that his memory of former life is very limited and attributes this tentatively to whatever sealed him; Caul learns this actual disclosure, not details of tomb location, mechanism, duration, Reborn mechanics, vulnerabilities, or proof of memory cause. V asks her firsthand knowledge of ancestral seat. Caul describes remembered pre-Convergence seat as fortified seat of government with court residences, administrative chambers, archives, gardens, soldier/servant quarters and diplomatic reception. These are newly established bounded historical layout descriptions, consistent with established Silver Court and former courtier; no precise modern footprint, surviving structures, ownership, value or other present state asserted. To make the known Silverward WNW bearing useful rather than repeat an empty lead, DM newly fixes Caul's firsthand historical approach recollection: the final main approach was a paved road climbing beside the aqueduct alignment; uphill waterworks included a substantial stone receiving cistern, while road reached a terraced outer court before a gate flanked by two square gatehouses. Historical route sketch shows relative relationships only, not cardinal modern map, coordinates, exact distances, new shortcut, safe travel or all features surviving the Convergence. Caul makes this rough annotated sketch and freely gives it to Mara with V's party present; it can be compared with actual Orsaven field-book/route-instrument/aqueduct evidence and surveyed traces to identify correct approach. No additional mandatory clue, fee, skill roll, ancestry verification or remote quest required; new prep must preserve remembered features and determine actual current survival/geography/access before chosen seat expedition, not move site after rolls. Caul honestly cannot say current condition, occupancy, distance, father's fate or what caused V's sealing. She offers practical advice to search for preserved dressed-stone watercourse, cistern and terraced approach rather than rely solely on a vanished road; Mara can guide survey from Silverward bearing. No expedition launched, no title, estate expansion, new employment, magic, expenditure, rest, combat, report to peers or resource change. Day334~20:30. Existing tower handover instrument, prisoner release order en route and conditional reform agreement unchanged.
